story: Implement a terminal UI around the engineering-process plugin to provide an interactive, visual interface for navigating phases, viewing progress, and managing workflow state

jtbd.context: When working through a multi-phase engineering workflow with the engineering-process plugin
jtbd.job: I want a visual, interactive interface that automates phase progression and shows me where I am
jtbd.outcome: So I can focus on actual engineering decisions rather than manually orchestrating slash commands and reading state files
